title.narrative: With Youth - Protection, assisted voluntary return and reintegration and health assistance to children and young migrants in Algeria. 2020-2022.

description.narrative: IOM Algeria will implement a project to contribute to improve protection and well-being of children and young migrants by enhancing their access to healthcare and protection support in Algeria. To achieve this objective, IOM Algeria will implement a series of initiatives in full complementarity with the established programmatic response in the country, particularly with regards to health promotion and Assisted Voluntary Return and Reintegration (AVRR). The project will target particularly children and young migrants, and particularly migrants in situations of vulnerability or having medical needs.
